powers.description: Check the venue's address and opening hours (read only).
Book a room (external effect, not idempotent at the provider).
Look up the status of an existing booking by its operation id.
Write to the provider's support to find a booking.
Send the final itinerary to the traveler (assumes the hotel is confirmed).
